full_judgment: 15. For the reasons stated above, it appears that the Court of appeal below as the final court of fact did not apply its judicial mind and independently assess the evidence and other materials on record in violation of its mandatory obligation under Order XLI, rules 31 and 33 of the Code of Civil Procedure, rather it misread and misappreciated the pleadings, evidence and other materials on record and came to an erroneous decision that the plaintiff failed to prove his possession in the suit land and, as such, the impugned judgment and decree is not a proper judgment of reversal as the fact that the learned Judge of the lower appellate court failed to arrive at its own independent findings on the issues involved in the suit, but reversed the decision of the learned Judge of the trial court on some legally impermissible and technical grounds without assigning any reason and also without reversing the findings of the Trial Court.
